t: 匈牙利的安德鲁三世去世,结束了匈牙利的阿尔帕德王朝.
te: Andrew III of Hungary dies, ending the Árpád dynasty in Hungary.
dz: 匈牙利的安德鲁三世去世,结束了匈牙利的阿尔帕德王朝.
de: Andrew III of Hungary dies, ending the Árpád dynasty in Hungary.

t: 凯尔纳尔冯的爱德华(后为英格兰国王爱德华二世)成为威尔士首位英国亲王.
te: Edward of Caernarvon (later King Edward II of England) becomes the first English Prince of Wales.
dz: 凯尔纳尔冯的爱德华(后为英格兰国王爱德华二世)成为威尔士首位英国亲王.
de: Edward of Caernarvon (later King Edward II of England) becomes the first English Prince of Wales.
